items.topic: numeric event decay, stale-event interval, automatic expiry, and de-escalation expiry
items.whyEvidenceIsInsufficient: Session 15 observed 184 repeated observations but zero post-initial lifecycle transitions. It therefore contains no empirical transition-time or outcome distribution from which to calibrate a duration or rate.
items.safeSession18Or19Behavior: Persist continuing clusters, update lastObservedAt on repeats, leave lastMaterialChangeAt unchanged, and make continuing non-elevating. Permit de-escalation only from an explicit material evidence record. Apply no decay, expiry, staleness, or inferred transition.
items.blockEffect: does not block isolated parallel implementation; any later automatic decay or expiry requires a new methodology version and is outside the 2.0.0 cutover
items.evidenceNeeded: Prospective reviewed lifecycle-transition records with reliable material-change times, false-persistence analysis, and outcome-sensitive comparison across candidate intervals.
items.futureGate: post-parallel methodology review after the 30-close minimum; new-version decision, not an implementation default

items.topic: fuzzy automatic-clustering similarity thresholds and actor/time/location windows
items.whyEvidenceIsInsufficient: Session 15 establishes heavy duplication and unresolved assignments but does not provide a labeled out-of-sample error surface for numeric similarity or incident windows.
items.safeSession18Or19Behavior: Automatically join only on the two frozen exact-match rules with no assessed-field conflict. Persist every other proposal and require assisted-human-confirmed or human disposition; unresolved candidates do not score.
items.blockEffect: does not block isolated parallel implementation; blocks any broader automatic join behavior and blocks cutover if ambiguous decisions are unrecorded
items.evidenceNeeded: Prospective adjudicated join/non-join labels, false-merge and false-split analysis by rule, and an independent holdout evaluation.
items.futureGate: parallel gate PA-04 and independent post-freeze validation

items.topic: durable private storage backend, retention duration, tiering, disaster recovery, and service level
items.whyEvidenceIsInsufficient: Session 15 estimated JSONL volume but did not establish production throughput, contractual retention, recovery-time objectives, or a selected durable service. Session 16 provides a frozen audit volume, not an operating forecast.
items.safeSession18Or19Behavior: Use access-controlled non-public local storage, immutable per-run files, hashes, append-only registry lineage, and no pruning. Keep public namespaces empty unless separately authorized. Treat any irreproducible run as ineligible for cutover.
items.blockEffect: does not block isolated parallel implementation; blocks public cutover
items.evidenceNeeded: Measured parallel-run volume and latency, source-license review, recovery drill, retention approval, and documented RPO/RTO ownership.
items.futureGate: parallel gate PA-09 before cutover authorization

items.topic: automatic stale-lock timeout and lock takeover
items.whyEvidenceIsInsufficient: No production v2 runtime, writer-concurrency distribution, or crash-recovery evidence exists, so a timeout would be invented.
items.safeSession18Or19Behavior: Use atomic exclusive-create locks. Any existing lock blocks the writer. Recovery is a persisted human decision followed by a new run; never delete or take over a lock automatically.
items.blockEffect: does not block single-writer parallel implementation; blocks automatic takeover behavior
items.evidenceNeeded: Parallel runtime measurements, crash simulations, duplicate-writer tests, and an approved recovery procedure.
items.futureGate: Session 18 implementation review and PA-02 determinism gate

items.topic: complete exchange-holiday/early-close calendar and reliable provider availability timestamps
items.whyEvidenceIsInsufficient: Session 16 froze date-only FRED observations, could not reconstruct historical release vintages, and explicitly lacked complete holiday, early-close, and intraday availability metadata.
items.safeSession18Or19Behavior: Use the frozen UTC Monday-Friday age convention and 16:00 America/New_York weekday close. Do not infer holiday or early-close adjustments. Mark missing or unreliable availability times unknown; mark a reliable after-close signal pending until the next eligible weekday close.
items.blockEffect: does not block parallel implementation; unknown-timing records cannot enter a four-state assessment and material unresolved coverage may extend the parallel window or block cutover
items.evidenceNeeded: Versioned exchange calendars, provider-specific availability timestamps, reliability audits, and measured unknown/pending rates during parallel operation.
items.futureGate: PA-06, PA-07, and independent post-freeze validation

items.topic: raw-response retention where source terms restrict storage
items.whyEvidenceIsInsufficient: The audits classify privacy and preserve available responses but do not constitute a legal or contractual retention determination for every future provider.
items.safeSession18Or19Behavior: Keep raw data private when permitted; otherwise persist a lossless normalized equivalent, retrieval metadata, retention status, and available content identity. Do not publish raw inputs or credentials. A run that cannot be independently reproduced is not cutover-eligible.
items.blockEffect: does not block permitted-source parallel implementation; blocks cutover for any non-reproducible required source
items.evidenceNeeded: Provider-by-provider terms review, approved retention matrix, and an independent reconstruction test.
items.futureGate: PA-05 and PA-09 before cutover authorization
